subject: Post-demo: paperflow scope & onboarding checklist for Acme Systems
body:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@acmesystems.com>, procurement@acmesystems.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: paperflow scope & onboarding checklist for Acme Systems

Hi Lena / Acme procurement team,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — great conversation. Wanted to capture the procurement/activation path we discussed and make the onboarding checklist explicit so we can avoid surprises on your end. Below is a concise summary and next steps.

Summary (what we heard)
- You prefer to use a PO process for platform commitments (central purchasing).
- Finance needs a vendor packet (W-9 for tax, bank instructions for ACH) + contractor/vendor form filled out.
- Marketplace (AWS Marketplace) is interesting for future purchases but not required for this initial POC.
- Need invoice terms (Net 30) and an estimate of ramped monthly committed spend for SOW/contract.

Immediate checklist (items we can own / who)
1) Redwood to provide: vendor packet template, sample invoice, and official W-9 — ACTION: Rishi (attached).
2) Acme to confirm: preferred payment path (PO -> invoice via email + ACH) or whether they will route via a card program for pilot months — ACTION: Lena / procurement.
3) If PO: provide procurement contact and send purchase order referencing deal RW-5238.
4) If marketplace desired: we can prepare marketplace activation notes; require internal procurement signoff.

Attachments included: RW_vendor_packet_Acme.pdf (vendor packet template), Acme_W-9_04-18-2027.pdf (fillable), bank_stub_ending_6789.png (example routing page).

Would love confirmation on the payment path and an estimated purchase order date so Marissa and I can line up the commercial paperwork. Happy to jump on a quick 20-min call with your procurement lead if helpful.

Thanks,
Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123


-----Original Message-----
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@acmesystems.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmesystems.com
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: paperflow scope & onboarding checklist for Acme Systems

Thanks Rishi — useful recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- We are 95% certain we'll do PO/invoice for the initial POC (legal wants that trail).
- I can share the purchase order template and our AP routing details by EOD Wednesday.
- We will need Redwood's vendor tax ID and an address for the W-9 — I see the W-9 attached but is the vendor name exactly "Redwood Inference, Inc."?
- Marketplace is something our platform team will evaluate later this quarter; can be a follow-up.

I'll loop in Sam from procurement on the PO specifics.

Best,
Lena

--
Lena Ortiz
Director, Finance Operations
Acme Systems
lena@acmesystems.com


From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@acmesystems.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: paperflow scope & onboarding checklist for Acme Systems

Awesome, Lena — I can take point on the vendor packet once we have the PO preference. A couple of notes from ops:

- Confirmed vendor name: "Redwood Inference, Inc." (matches tax filing).
- W-9 attached is the correct form; I'll re-export a PDF with our corporate address and EIN masked for this thread, but full copy can be shared via DocuSign if you prefer secure handling.
- For ACH we will need: account name, routing number, account number, and a recent bank letter or voided check — the bank_stub_ending_6789.png is an example of acceptable artifact.
- If you route via a purchasing card for the pilot, note that our billing system incurs a card processing surcharge; we can include that in the SOW.

Next steps suggestion: Lena/Sam share PO template + target PO date; if PO arrives this week our standard onboarding timeline is 5–7 business days for vendor setup and token provisioning for pilot usage.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai


From: Sam Park <sam.park@acmesystems.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lena Ortiz <lena@acmesystems.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: paperflow scope & onboarding checklist for Acme Systems

Marissa/Rishi,

We will send a PO template by COB today and target sending the signed PO early next week (Monday). Confirming that Redwood's EIN is the only tax info we need right now. Also: can you provide an estimated invoice date schedule (e.g., invoice sent on provisioning; net 30 due) and a single point of contact on billing for follow-ups?

I'll attach the PO template in a follow-up email.

Regards,
Sam

--
Sam Park
Senior Procurement Analyst
Acme Systems
sam.park@acmesystems.com
